# Market Analytica

Market Analytica designs custom market-research, forecasting, and
decision-intelligence platforms. Companies engage us to rank opportunities,
forecast demand, evaluate risk, monitor competitors, and turn scattered
research into clear, recurring business decisions.

## Capabilities

- Market Opportunity Scoring: rank products, markets, or investments using custom criteria — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/market-opportunity-scoring
- Forecasting & Scenarios: model likely outcomes, risks, and future market changes — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/forecasting-scenarios
- Competitive Intelligence: compare competitors, pricing, positioning, and whitespace — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/competitive-intelligence
- Executive Dashboards: convert complex research into decision-making tools — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/executive-dashboards
- Data Integration: combine company data with external research and market signals — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/data-integration
- Custom Analytics Systems: platforms built around each client's workflow — https://marketanalytica.com/capabilities/custom-analytics-systems

## Notes

LootSignal is an independent research and analysis system. Franchise and brand
names appear as subjects of market analysis; inclusion implies no affiliation
with, endorsement by, or licensing rights from any rights holder.
